cues: Light dumbbells, slight bend in your elbows.
Raise to shoulder height, no higher.
Lower slowly. If you swing it, go lighter.

moves.name: Stomach vacuum
cues: Pull your belly button in toward your spine.
Hold 20 seconds. Short breaths through your nose.
